papers.title: A Tissue Virus Microenvironment with Activated Stress Responses Underlies Durable SIV Persistence
papers.translated_title: 具有激活应激反应的组织病毒微环境是SIV持久存续的基础
papers.author: Hope, T. J.
papers.summary: HIV persistence during suppressive antiretroviral therapy (ART) remains a central barrier to cure, with the majority of reservoirs residing in gut-associated lymphoid tissues (GALT). Here, we define a spatially organized viral microenvironment (VME) that sustains reservoir durability and governs early viral rebound by comparing animals initiating ART early after infection (transient reservoirs) versus late (persistent reservoirs). Using immunoPET/CT-guided sampling of SIV-infected rhesus macaques combined with spatial transcriptomics, we interrogated tissue sites of viral production during the eclipse phase following analytical treatment interruption (ATI). Our results revealed that viral rebound from persistent reservoirs arises from discrete, transcriptionally active foci enriched in the mucosa lining the gut lumen. Eclipse phase persistent reservoirs were characterized by increased proviral burden and a distinct tissue state marked by activation of stress-response, metabolic, mitochondrial, and cell cycle programs coupled to repression of cytoplasmic translation and increased cellular senescence. These features co-occurred with immunosuppressive cellular architectures resembling tertiary lymphoid structures enriched for Treg cells, innate lymphoid cells, and mast cells, regulated by Treg-centered cell-cell interaction networks. In contrast, transient reservoirs displayed enhanced translational and metabolic activity and were embedded within immune-active environments enriched for CD8+ T cells, Th17, Tfh, and activated CD4+ T cells. Machine learning identified stress adaptation, hypoxia, metabolic rewiring, and cytoskeletal remodeling pathways as dominant predictors of viral density within persistent VMEs, with strong convergence on programs observed in tumor microenvironments (TME). Orthogonal validation confirmed activation of the integrated stress response (ISR) at sites of viral production in concurrence with results of immunofluorescent microscopy revealing SIV gag expression in two populations primarily in the mucosa, differentiated by the phosphorylation of eIF2alpha. Together, these findings establish the VME as a critical determinant of reservoir persistence, integrating immune regulation, tissue remodeling, and translational control to enable viral survival. This framework suggests that effective HIV cure strategies will require coordinated disruption of VME-supportive functions in addition to targeting infected cells.
papers.translated_summary: HIV在抑制性抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）期间的持续存在仍然是治愈的核心障碍，大多数病毒储存库位于肠道相关淋巴组织（GALT）中。在此，我们通过比较感染后早期启动ART的动物（短暂储存库）与晚期启动ART的动物（持续储存库），定义了一个空间组织化的病毒微环境（VME），该微环境维持储存库的持久性并决定早期病毒反弹。利用免疫PET/CT引导的SIV感染恒河猴采样结合空间转录组学，我们探究了分析性治疗中断（ATI）后隐匿期病毒产生的组织部位。我们的结果揭示，持续储存库的病毒反弹源于离散的、转录活跃的病灶，富集于衬覆肠腔的黏膜中。隐匿期持续储存库的特征是前病毒载量增加以及一种独特的组织状态，表现为应激反应、代谢、线粒体和细胞周期程序的激活，同时伴随细胞质翻译的抑制和细胞衰老的增加。这些特征与类似三级淋巴结构的免疫抑制性细胞架构同时出现，该架构富集Treg细胞、固有淋巴细胞和肥大细胞，受以Treg为中心的细胞间相互作用网络调控。相比之下，短暂储存库表现出增强的翻译和代谢活性，并嵌入免疫活跃环境中，富集CD8+ T细胞、Th17、Tfh和活化CD4+ T细胞。机器学习鉴定出应激适应、缺氧、代谢重编程和细胞骨架重塑通路是持续VME内病毒密度的主要预测因子，与肿瘤微环境（TME）中观察到的程序高度趋同。正交验证证实了病毒产生部位整合应激反应（ISR）的激活，与免疫荧光显微镜结果一致，后者显示SIV gag表达主要存在于黏膜中的两个细胞群体，通过eIF2alpha的磷酸化加以区分。总之，这些发现确立了VME作为储存库持久性的关键决定因素，整合免疫调节、组织重塑和翻译控制以促进病毒存活。这一框架表明，有效的HIV治愈策略除了靶向感染细胞外，还需要协同破坏支持VME的功能。

papers.title: Pericentrin contains internal adaptor-like sequences that activate dynein directly
papers.translated_title: Pericentrin 含有内部的接头样序列，可直接激活动力蛋白。
papers.author: Zhang, W.
papers.summary: Centrosome maturation, the rapid growth of the centrosome before cell division, prepares the cell for spindle assembly. Pericentrin (PCNT), a coiled-coil centrosomal protein, is transported to the centrosome by dynein during its translation, and this co-translational transport promotes maturation. How dynein engages PCNT remains unclear. We show that PCNT residues 1393-1525 are required for the dynein-dynactin interaction. This region shares bulk sequence features with canonical dynein cargo adaptors, and three of five synthetic sequences matching these features fully or partially restored transport of a PCNT variant lacking residues 1393-1525. PCNT is predicted to contact dynein heavy chain at sites used by canonical adaptors, and mutating these sites abolished transport. Purified PCNT activated dynein-dynactin directly without additional factors. These results suggest that PCNT binds and activates dynein through an adaptor-like sequence, with no separate adaptor, and that dynein recognizes cargoes by more diverse mechanisms than previously recognized, including an internal rather than N-terminal binding region.
papers.translated_summary: 中心体成熟，即细胞分裂前中心体的快速生长，为细胞进行纺锤体组装做好准备。Pericentrin（PCNT）是一种卷曲螺旋中心体蛋白，在其翻译过程中由动力蛋白运输至中心体，这种共翻译运输促进中心体成熟。动力蛋白如何与PCNT结合尚不清楚。我们发现PCNT第1393-1525位残基是动力蛋白-动力蛋白激活蛋白相互作用所必需的。该区域与经典动力蛋白货物衔接蛋白具有大量序列特征相似性，而五条符合这些特征的合成序列中有三条完全或部分恢复了缺乏第1393-1525位残基的PCNT变体的运输。预测PCNT在经典衔接蛋白所使用的位点接触动力蛋白重链，突变这些位点则废除了运输。纯化的PCNT无需额外因子即可直接激活动力蛋白-动力蛋白激活蛋白。这些结果表明，PCNT通过一个类似衔接蛋白的序列结合并激活动力蛋白，而无需单独的衔接蛋白，并且动力蛋白识别货物的机制比此前所认识的更为多样，包括内部而非N端的结合区域。

papers.title: Oxygen-permeable microwell plates for high-throughput spheroid culture
papers.translated_title: 用于高通量球状体培养的透氧微孔板
papers.author: Takahashi, J.
papers.summary: Oxygen (O2) transport is a major limitation in high-density cell culture, particularly as three-dimensional (3D) spheroids are increasingly used to better mimic in vivo tissue environments. Here, we developed a poly(4-methyl-1-pentene) (PMP)-based microwell platform, leveraging its lower molecular absorption and greater mechanical stability than the commonly used O2-permeable polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), while retaining high O2 permeability. We measured O2 permeability in 50-m-thick PMP membranes and found approximately 200-fold greater O2 permeability than the conventional 1-mm polystyrene culture-plate material. PMP membrane-based microwell plates with 350-m-diameter wells maintained spatial separation of pre-formed hepatocyte spheroids while supplying O2 from the plate bottom, synergistically enhancing spheroid oxygenation. Compared with non-O2-permeable plates, the platform reduced localized hypoxia and hypoxia-associated cell injury while improving spheroid viability and growth. Collectively, PMP-based O2-permeable microwell plates provide a promising, scalable, high-throughput platform for spheroid culture with multiple applications in tissue engineering, drug screening and beyond.
papers.translated_summary: 氧气（O2）运输是高密度细胞培养中的主要限制因素，尤其是随着三维（3D）球状体越来越多地用于更好地模拟体内组织环境。在此，我们开发了一种基于聚（4-甲基-1-戊烯）（PMP）的微孔平台，利用其比常用的氧气可渗透聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）更低的分子吸附和更高的机械稳定性，同时保持高氧气渗透性。我们测量了50微米厚PMP膜中的氧气渗透性，发现其氧气渗透性比传统的1毫米聚苯乙烯培养板材料高约200倍。具有350微米直径孔的PMP膜基微孔板维持了预形成肝细胞球状体的空间分离，同时从板底供应氧气，协同增强了球状体的氧合。与不可渗透氧气的板相比，该平台减少了局部缺氧和缺氧相关的细胞损伤，同时改善了球状体的活力和生长。总体而言，基于PMP的氧气可渗透微孔板为球状体培养提供了一个有前景、可扩展、高通量的平台，在组织工程、药物筛选及其他领域具有多种应用。

papers.title: PatientPheX: A Full-Text Biomedical Corpus for Patient-Specific Phenotype Information Extraction
papers.translated_title: PatientPheX：一个用于患者特异性表型信息抽取的全文本生物医学语料库
papers.author: Zhu, X.
papers.summary: Patient-specific phenotype information extraction identifiers and normalizes phenotype entities and links them with individual patients, supporting rare disease research and genotype-phenotype analysis. However, existing datasets rarely combine full-text biomedical content with detailed annotations of patients, phenotypes, related entities, and their associations. In this work, we present PatientPheX, a corpus for patient-specific phenotype information extraction comprising 200 full-text articles, primarily case reports and case series. The corpus provides mention annotations and normalization for seven biomedical entity types, together with explicit associations between patients and entities across sentences, paragraphs, and sections. Negated findings and composite phenotype mentions are also annotated. Corpus construction combines automated pre-annotation, large language model (LLM)-assisted verification, and manual review and adjudication. Benchmarks cover entity recognition and normalization and patient-phenotype association extraction using gold-standard and predicted entities. The overall document-level entity F1 was 86.95%, while phenotype F1 was 79.33%. The best relation extraction macro-F1 decreased from 84.14% with gold-standard entities to 54.98% with predicted entities, highlighting the combined challenges of phenotype extraction and patient attribution. PatientPheX provides a resource for developing and evaluating patient-centered information extraction methods and supports the construction of structured patient-level knowledge resources for phenotype-driven biomedical research.
papers.translated_summary: 患者特异性表型信息抽取标识符对表型实体进行识别与规范化，并将其与个体患者关联，从而支持罕见病研究和基因型-表型分析。然而，现有数据集很少将全文生物医学内容与患者、表型、相关实体及其关联的详细标注相结合。在本研究中，我们提出了PatientPheX，一个用于患者特异性表型信息抽取的语料库，包含200篇全文文章，主要是病例报告和病例系列。该语料库提供了七种生物医学实体类型的提及标注和规范化，以及跨句子、段落和章节的患者与实体之间的显式关联。否定性发现和复合表型提及也进行了标注。语料库构建结合了自动预标注、大语言模型（LLM）辅助验证以及人工审核与裁定。基准测试涵盖实体识别与规范化以及使用金标准和预测实体的患者-表型关联抽取。整体文档级实体F1为86.95%，而表型F1为79.33%。最佳关系抽取宏F1从使用金标准实体时的84.14%下降到使用预测实体时的54.98%，凸显了表型抽取与患者归属相结合所面临的挑战。PatientPheX为开发和评估以患者为中心的信息抽取方法提供了资源，并支持为表型驱动的生物医学研究构建结构化的患者级知识资源。

papers.title: Transfer seeding reveals divergent activation ensembles across tyrosine kinases
papers.translated_title: 转移播种揭示了酪氨酸激酶之间不同的激活集合
papers.author: Zhu, Y.
papers.summary: Protein kinase activation involves coordinated rearrangements of conserved regulatory elements, including the Asp--Phe--Gly (DFG) motif and activation loop (A-loop), but whether tyrosine kinases follow a universal activation mechanism remains unclear. This motivates the need for a common protocol to generate comparable conformational ensembles despite uneven experimental structural coverage across kinases. Here we combine over 8.3 milliseconds of distributed unbiased molecular dynamics simulations with Markov state models (MSMs) to compare the conformational landscapes of the ABL, EGFR and MET kinase domains. To expand conformational coverage while retaining unbiased dynamics, we use a transfer seeding strategy that steers AlphaFold2 models derived from homologous templates to sample MET conformational states absent from available experimental databases. Our MSMs resolve metastable conformations not represented in the experimental structural set, including low-population DFG-inter intermediates along the MET activation pathway. We find that activation pathways are kinase-specific rather than universal. A-loop rearrangements contribute to the rate-limiting steps in ABL and MET, whereas EGFR is rate limited by a local rearrangement of the DFG motif. Building on established DFG geometry nomenclature, ensemble level characterization of the A-loop further distinguishes metastable conformations that share the same DFG geometry and reveal kinase-specific differences in phosphosite accessibility along their activation landscapes. Our results provide a systematic framework for comparative kinase ensemble characterization, integrating DFG geometry with A-loop and other regulatory elements to resolve kinase-specific states and the atomic-resolution structural rearrangements underlying their interconversion.
papers.translated_summary: 蛋白激酶激活涉及保守调控元件的协同重排，包括Asp-Phe-Gly（DFG）基序和激活环（A-loop），但酪氨酸激酶是否遵循统一的激活机制仍不清楚。这促使我们需要一个通用方案，以在激酶之间实验结构覆盖不均的情况下生成可比较的构象集合。在此，我们将超过8.3毫秒的分布式无偏分子动力学模拟与马尔可夫状态模型（MSMs）相结合，比较ABL、EGFR和MET激酶结构域的构象景观。为了在保持无偏动力学的同时扩展构象覆盖，我们采用转移种子策略，引导源自同源模板的AlphaFold2模型采样现有实验数据库中缺失的MET构象状态。我们的MSMs解析了实验结构集中未代表的亚稳态构象，包括MET激活通路中低布居的DFG-in中间体。我们发现激活通路是激酶特异性的，而非通用的。A-loop重排促成了ABL和MET中的限速步骤，而EGFR则受DFG基序局部重排的限速。在已建立的DFG几何命名基础上，A-loop的集合水平表征进一步区分了共享相同DFG几何的亚稳态构象，并揭示了沿其激活景观的磷酸位点可及性方面的激酶特异性差异。我们的结果提供了一个用于比较性激酶集合表征的系统框架，将DFG几何与A-loop及其他调控元件整合，以解析激酶特异性状态及其相互转化背后的原子分辨率结构重排。

papers.title: A Thermodynamic Theory of Axon Guidance: Navigation Through High-Entropy Signaling States
papers.translated_title: 轴突导向的热力学理论：穿越高熵信号状态的导航
papers.author: Wadsworth, W. G.
papers.summary: Precise neural circuit formation requires growth cones to integrate multiple, sometimes competing, guidance signals into persistent yet adaptable movement. Here, we propose a theoretical framework that recasts axon guidance as a thermodynamically regulated computation. An artificial neural network, trained on in vivo genetic data and associated outgrowth patterns, maps the microstates of a localized guidance signaling network to macroscopic outgrowth behaviors. Using the trained model, we simulated axon pathfinding through extracellular gradients of molecular cues and created dynamic entropic landscapes. These results reveal that growth cones navigate high-entropy ridges that preserve plasticity. Navigation along these ridges supports persistent extension, whereas turning and branching occur near boundaries between competing entropic macrostates, consistent with transitions in the cytoskeletal machinery that controls growth-cone movement. More broadly, the framework proposes that robust biological patterning can emerge from microscopic variability when signaling networks operate near boundaries between competing behavioral states.
papers.translated_summary: 精确的神经回路形成需要生长锥将多种有时相互竞争的导向信号整合为持续但可适应的运动。在此，我们提出一个理论框架，将轴突导向重新表述为热力学调控的计算。一个在体内遗传数据及相关生长模式上训练的人工神经网络，将局部导向信号网络的微观状态映射到宏观生长行为。利用训练后的模型，我们模拟了轴突在分子线索的细胞外梯度中的路径寻找，并创建了动态熵景观。这些结果揭示，生长锥在高熵脊上导航，从而保持可塑性。沿这些脊的导航支持持续延伸，而转向和分支发生在竞争性熵宏观状态之间的边界附近，这与控制生长锥运动的细胞骨架机制的转变一致。更广泛地说，该框架提出，当信号网络在竞争性行为状态之间的边界附近运行时，稳健的生物模式化可以从微观变异性中涌现。

papers.title: Decoupling of spontaneous and evoked activity in locus coeruleus neurons: early synaptic and ion-channel remodeling in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease
papers.translated_title: 蓝斑神经元自发活动和诱发活动的解耦：阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型中的早期突触和离子通道重塑
papers.author: Zhao, B.
papers.summary: The locus coeruleus (LC) is among the earliest brain regions affected in Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet the mechanisms underlying its early vulnerability remain poorly understood. Clarifying synaptic and intrinsic dysfunction in LC noradrenergic (NE) neurons is essential to determine how noradrenergic circuit failure contributes to prodromal AD. We combined whole-cell patch-clamp recordings with quantitative immunofluorescence to examine synaptic transmission, firing properties, voltage-gated currents, and synaptic organization in LC/NE neurons from young 3xTg mice prior to substantial neurodegeneration. Young 3xTg mice exhibited reduced excitatory and enhanced inhibitory synaptic input onto LC/NE neurons. Consistent with these functional shifts, structural analysis revealed decreased densities of VGLUT2, PSD95, and paired VGLUT2-PSD95 puncta, alongside increased VGAT, gephyrin, and paired VGAT-gephyrin puncta. Despite this net synaptic suppression, LC/NE neurons displayed elevated spontaneous firing rates but a markedly reduced capacity to generate spike output during sustained depolarization. Voltage-clamp recordings revealed a diminished total voltage-gated K current density alongside reduced voltage-gated Na current density, without significant shifts in their voltage-dependence or kinetics. These biophysical alterations provide a mechanistic basis for the divergent firing phenotype: reduced K current; conductance likely facilitates spontaneous pacemaker activity, whereas diminished Na current; current constrains repetitive, input-driven spike generation. Together, these findings demonstrate that LC/NE neurons undergo coordinated synaptic and ion-channel remodeling during prodromal AD. This unique decoupling of spontaneous baseline activity from stimulus-evoked excitability may impair dynamic noradrenergic modulation, positioning early LC cellular dysfunction as a candidate driver of network instability and a novel therapeutic target.
papers.translated_summary: 蓝斑（LC）是阿尔茨海默病（AD）中最早受累的脑区之一，但其早期易损性的机制仍知之甚少。阐明LC去甲肾上腺素能（NE）神经元的突触和内在功能障碍，对于确定去甲肾上腺素能回路失效如何促进前驱期AD至关重要。我们将全细胞膜片钳记录与定量免疫荧光相结合，在发生显著神经退行性变之前的年轻3xTg小鼠中，检测LC/NE神经元的突触传递、放电特性、电压门控电流和突触组织。年轻3xTg小鼠的LC/NE神经元表现出兴奋性突触输入减少和抑制性突触输入增强。与这些功能改变一致，结构分析显示VGLUT2、PSD95以及配对的VGLUT2-PSD95斑点的密度降低，同时VGAT、gephyrin以及配对的VGAT-gephyrin斑点的密度增加。尽管存在这种净突触抑制，LC/NE神经元仍表现出升高的自发放电频率，但在持续去极化期间产生锋电位输出的能力显著降低。电压钳记录显示，总电压门控K电流密度降低，同时电压门控Na电流密度也降低，而其电压依赖性或动力学没有显著变化。这些生物物理改变为这种分歧的放电表型提供了机制基础：K电流降低可能促进自发起搏活动，而Na电流降低则限制了重复的、输入驱动的锋电位生成。总之，这些发现表明LC/NE神经元在前驱期AD期间经历了协调的突触和离子通道重塑。这种自发性基线活动与刺激诱发的兴奋性之间的独特解耦可能损害动态去甲肾上腺素能调制，使早期LC细胞功能障碍成为网络不稳定性的候选驱动因素和新的治疗靶点。

papers.title: Multiple Pol determinants constrain koala retrovirus A replication
papers.translated_title: 多个Pol决定簇限制考拉逆转录病毒A的复制
papers.author: Abajorga, M.
papers.summary: Koala retrovirus subtype A (KoRV-A) is a gammaretrovirus that occurs in both endogenous and horizontally transmissible forms in wild koala populations. KoRV infection is associated with neoplasia and increased susceptibility to opportunistic infections. Its ongoing incorporation into the koala germline provides a rare contemporary example of retroviral endogenization in a mammalian host. We generated a consensus KoRV-A clone using viral sequences from an infected wild koala and compared it with a published clone representing a viral isolate from a captive koala. Both replicated far less efficiently than Moloney murine leukemia virus (Mo-MLV), the best-characterized gammaretrovirus, during spreading infection in human cell lines, prompting us to investigate the viral features underlying this difference. Following transfection, KoRV-A and Mo-MLV produced comparable levels of viral RNA and intracellular Gag and Pol proteins, yet KoRV-A yielded approximately 1,000-fold less particle-associated reverse transcriptase (RT) activity and markedly lower amounts of Gag- and Pol-derived proteins in released virions. Reduced accumulation of extracellular viral proteins persisted with protease-inactive precursors, indicating that impaired proteolytic maturation alone could not explain this phenotype. KoRV-A/Mo-MLV chimeras showed that particle-associated RT activity depended on both RT sequence and compatibility between protease (PR) and the cleavage sites flanking RT; replacement of the entire KoRV-A PR-RT region with Mo-MLV sequence restored RT activity to near Mo-MLV levels. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and spatial analysis revealed that KoRV-A virions accumulated in substantially larger and denser extracellular clusters than Mo-MLV virions. RT and PR-RT chimeras exhibited increased particle abundance and apparent clustering, although most spatial differences were attenuated after accounting for particle density. Whether extracellular particle aggregation contributes directly to inefficient replication remains unclear. Together, these findings identify coordinated interactions among PR, RT, and their cleavage-site context as determinants of KoRV-A enzymatic activity and reveal an unusual extracellular particle organization associated with a gammaretrovirus.
papers.translated_summary: 考拉逆转录病毒A亚型（KoRV-A）是一种γ逆转录病毒，在野生考拉种群中以内源性和水平传播两种形式存在。KoRV感染与肿瘤发生及机会性感染易感性增加相关。其正在整合入考拉生殖细胞系的过程，为逆转录病毒在哺乳动物宿主中内源化提供了一个罕见的当代实例。我们利用来自一只受感染野生考拉的病毒序列构建了一个一致性KoRV-A克隆，并将其与一个已发表的、代表来自圈养考拉病毒分离株的克隆进行了比较。在人类细胞系中的扩散性感染过程中，两者的复制效率均远低于莫洛尼鼠白血病病毒（Mo-MLV）——特征最为明确的γ逆转录病毒，这促使我们研究造成这一差异的病毒特征。转染后，KoRV-A和Mo-MLV产生的病毒RNA以及细胞内Gag和Pol蛋白水平相当，但KoRV-A产生的与颗粒相关的逆转录酶（RT）活性约低1，000倍，且释放的病毒粒子中Gag和Pol衍生蛋白的量显著更低。细胞外病毒蛋白积累减少的现象在蛋白酶无活性前体中也持续存在，表明仅蛋白水解成熟受损并不能解释这一表型。KoRV-A/Mo-MLV嵌合体显示，与颗粒相关的RT活性既取决于RT序列，也取决于蛋白酶（PR）与RT两侧切割位点之间的相容性；将整个KoRV-A PR-RT区域替换为Mo-MLV序列后，RT活性恢复至接近Mo-MLV水平。透射电子显微镜（TEM）和空间分析显示，KoRV-A病毒粒子积聚成的细胞外团簇明显大于且密度高于Mo-MLV病毒粒子。RT和PR-RT嵌合体表现出颗粒丰度增加和明显的聚集，不过在考虑颗粒密度后，大多数空间差异减弱。细胞外颗粒聚集是否直接导致复制效率低下仍不清楚。总之，这些发现确定了PR、RT及其切割位点背景之间协同相互作用是KoRV-A酶活性的决定因素，并揭示了一种与γ逆转录病毒相关的异常细胞外颗粒组织方式。

papers.title: Neonatal Delivery of Exon Skipping Therapeutics Maximizes Brain Dystrophin Rescue in the Mdx52 Mouse Model of Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
papers.translated_title: 新生儿递送外显子跳跃治疗药物在杜氏肌营养不良症Mdx52小鼠模型中最大化脑内抗肌萎缩蛋白拯救
papers.author: VACCA, O.
papers.summary: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is caused by mutations in the DMD gene, resulting in the loss of dystrophin expression. Beyond progressive muscle degeneration, nearly half of patients exhibit cognitive and behavioral impairments, highlighting the need for effective central nervous system (CNS) therapies. In this study, we investigated whether neonatal delivery could maximize brain dystrophin rescue in mdx52 mice using exon 51 skipping strategies. We compared systemic and intracerebroventricular (ICV) delivery of an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO-51) and an AAV9-mediated U7snRNA approach (scAAV9-U7-Ex51), administered neonatally. Neonatal intravenous ASO-51 induced widespread but transient exon skipping, resulting in limited brain dystrophin restoration. ICV administration markedly increased CNS exon skipping but did not overcome the limited persistence of ASO, leading to progressive loss of exon skipping and dystrophin rescue. In contrast, neonatal ICV delivery of scAAV9-U7-Ex51 achieved robust, widespread, and sustained exon 51 skipping throughout the brain, including the hippocampus, cortex, and cerebellum, resulting in 20-50% restoration of Dp427 expression. These findings demonstrate that early CNS-directed delivery enhances brain dystrophin restoration and establish AAV-U7-mediated exon skipping as a promising strategy for addressing CNS comorbidities in DMD.
papers.translated_summary: 杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）由DMD基因突变引起，导致抗肌萎缩蛋白表达缺失。除进行性肌肉退化外，近半数患者还表现出认知和行为障碍，凸显了对有效中枢神经系统（CNS）疗法的需求。在本研究中，我们探讨了新生儿期递送能否通过外显子51跳跃策略在mdx52小鼠中最大化脑内抗肌萎缩蛋白的恢复。我们比较了新生儿期全身递送和脑室内（ICV）递送反义寡核苷酸（ASO-51）以及AAV9介导的U7snRNA方法（scAAV9-U7-Ex51）。新生儿期静脉注射ASO-51诱导了广泛但短暂的外显子跳跃，导致脑内抗肌萎缩蛋白恢复有限。ICV给药显著增加了CNS外显子跳跃，但未能克服ASO持久性有限的问题，导致外显子跳跃和抗肌萎缩蛋白恢复逐渐丧失。相比之下，新生儿期ICV递送scAAV9-U7-Ex51在全脑实现了稳健、广泛且持续的外显子51跳跃，包括海马、皮层和小脑，导致Dp427表达恢复20-50%。这些发现表明，早期CNS靶向递送增强了脑内抗肌萎缩蛋白的恢复，并确立了AAV-U7介导的外显子跳跃作为解决DMD中枢神经系统共病的一种有前景的策略。

papers.title: Motor Evoked Potentials in Preclinical Models of Spinal Cord Injury and Stroke in Rodents: A Systematic Review.
papers.translated_title: 啮齿动物脊髓损伤和卒中临床前模型中的运动诱发电位：一项系统综述
papers.author: Shahid, R.
papers.summary: Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) serve as an invaluable tool for assessing corticospinal tract (CST) integrity and motor pathway function in preclinical models of spinal cord injury (SCI) and stroke. Despite their diagnostic and prognostic utility, substantial methodological variability persists across studies, complicating interpretation and cross-study comparisons. This systematic review synthesizes MEP acquisition and interpretation protocols from 83 rodent SCI and stroke studies published since 2015, aiming to outline common practices, identify sources of variability, and highlight methodological gaps. Our analysis reveals a predominance of SCI models and a focus on hindlimb MEPs, employing diverse stimulation protocols including transcranial electrical stimulation (TES), direct cortical stimulation (DCoS), and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). Anesthetic approaches are notably heterogeneous, representing a potentially large source of variability in MEP acquisition. Amplitude and latency, often measured jointly, emerged as the most frequently reported MEP parameters. Critically, MEPs bridge cellular and molecular changes to observable behaviour by reflecting the integrated functionality of neural cell populations and their circuits. However, a lack of standardization in reporting, particularly for secondary electrophysiological features and stimulation intensity, hinders reproducibility. We emphasize the necessity for standardized protocols for stimulation, electrode positioning, and data analysis, particularly the use of comprehensive recruitment curves. Adopting these best practices will enhance the transparency, comparability, and translational potential of MEP methodology in advancing our understanding and treatment strategies for neurological disorders.
papers.translated_summary: 运动诱发电位（MEPs）是评估脊髓损伤（SCI）和脑卒中临床前模型中皮质脊髓束（CST）完整性及运动通路功能的宝贵工具。尽管其具有诊断和预后价值，但各研究之间仍存在显著的方法学差异，使结果解读和跨研究比较变得复杂。本系统综述综合了自2015年以来发表的83项啮齿类SCI和脑卒中研究中的MEP采集与解读方案，旨在概述常见实践、识别变异来源并突出方法学空白。我们的分析显示，SCI模型占主导地位，且研究聚焦于后肢MEPs，采用了多种刺激方案，包括经颅电刺激（TES）、直接皮质刺激（DCoS）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。麻醉方法明显异质，是MEP采集中潜在的一大变异来源。振幅和潜伏期通常联合测量，是最常报告的MEP参数。关键在于，MEPs通过反映神经细胞群体及其环路的整合功能，将细胞和分子变化与可观察行为联系起来。然而，报告缺乏标准化，尤其是次要电生理特征和刺激强度方面，阻碍了可重复性。我们强调有必要建立刺激、电极定位和数据分析的标准化方案，特别是使用全面的募集曲线。采用这些最佳实践将提升MEP方法学的透明度、可比性和转化潜力，从而推进我们对神经系统疾病的理解和治疗策略。

papers.title: The extent and durability of improvement in depressive symptoms, quality of life, and daily function with three years of vagus nerve stimulation in markedly treatment-resistant depression: A RECOVER study report
papers.translated_title: 迷走神经刺激三年对显著难治性抑郁症患者抑郁症状、生活质量和日常功能改善的程度与持久性：一项RECOVER研究报告
papers.author: Conway, C. R.
papers.summary: Background: In markedly treatment-resistant depression, the RECOVER trial compared the time course, extent, and durability of benefits in groups randomized to three years of active VNS (Early-Active) or one year of sham VNS followed by two years of active VNS (Delayed-Active). Methods: For 436 participants completing month-12 (M12) assessments (Early-Active N=221; Delayed-Active N=215), longitudinal mixed-effects models characterized trajectories of benefit over 36 months in categorical outcomes pooled across blinded depressive symptom and global improvement measures. Additional analyses examined the proportions benefiting and the degree and durability of benefits. Results: The Early-Active group had greater odds of improvement during the RCT phase (OR=1.66; 95% CI=1.17-2.35; P=0.005). This between-group difference increased until M12 and then progressively narrowed upon VNS activation in the Delayed-Active group, approaching parity by M36. Across both groups, emergence of new beneficiaries plateaued after 24 months of active VNS, but with participants progressively achieving higher degrees of benefit thereafter. Following activation, the Delayed-Active group had significant improvement in all six categorical outcome measures. Durability was strong across depressive symptoms, function, and quality-of-life outcomes. For participants receiving active VNS throughout, durability of response was 70% from M12 to M36. Conclusions: Active VNS was associated with improved benefits for both treatment groups over years 2 and 3. New beneficiaries emerged during the first two years of active VNS with continued progression to higher levels of benefit in the third year. These clinical benefits were highly durable. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT03887715.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在明显难治性抑郁症中，RECOVER试验比较了随机分为三年主动VNS（早期主动）或一年假VNS后两年主动VNS（延迟主动）两组在获益时程、程度和持久性方面的差异。方法：对于完成第12个月（M12）评估的436名参与者（早期主动组N=221；延迟主动组N=215），纵向混合效应模型描述了36个月内获益轨迹，这些轨迹基于盲法抑郁症状和整体改善测量汇总的分类结局。其他分析考察了获益比例以及获益程度和持久性。结果：早期主动组在RCT阶段改善的几率更高（OR=1.66；95% CI=1.17-2.35；P=0.005）。这种组间差异持续增大至M12，随后在延迟主动组激活VNS后逐渐缩小，到M36时接近持平。在两组中，新的获益者在主动VNS治疗24个月后趋于平台，但此后参与者逐渐获得更高程度的获益。激活后，延迟主动组在所有六项分类结局指标上均有显著改善。在抑郁症状、功能和生活质量结局方面，持久性很强。对于全程接受主动VNS的参与者，从M12到M36的应答持久性为70%。结论：主动VNS与两组在第2年和第3年获益改善相关。新的获益者在主动VNS治疗前两年出现，并在第三年继续进展至更高水平的获益。这些临床获益具有高度持久性。ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT03887715。

papers.title: MAP3K7 Loss of Function Causes Dilated Cardiomyopathy
papers.translated_title: MAP3K7功能缺失导致扩张型心肌病
papers.author: Josephs, K. S.
papers.summary: Background and Aims: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a genetically heterogeneous cause of heart failure and sudden cardiac death. Many patients remain without a molecular diagnosis. MAP3K7 encodes TAK1, a serine/threonine kinase important for cardiac homeostasis. MAP3K7 variants are an established cause of syndromic disease, including cardiospondylocarpofacial syndrome (CSCF), in which DCM has been occasionally reported. Here, we demonstrate that MAP3K7 variants can cause apparently isolated DCM, expanding the phenotypic spectrum of MAP3K7-related disorders. Methods: We integrated four lines of genetic evidence: de novo variation, common variant association, familial segregation, and rare variant enrichment, alongside functional characterisation. Results: In 117 paediatric cardiomyopathy trios from the 100,000 Genomes Project, two probands harboured rare de novo MAP3K7 missense variants, significantly more than expected (Bonferroni-adjusted p=0.036). Independent GWAS implicated MAP3K7 as a susceptibility locus for adult DCM. Across global DCM cohorts, we identified families harbouring rare MAP3K7 variants, including one with segregation in nine affected relatives (p.(Tyr125Cys), estimated LOD = 2.7). Rare damaging non-truncating variants were enriched in DCM versus INTERVAL (OR 22, p=0.007) and gnomAD controls (OR 14, p=6.2x10-4), while truncating variants were associated with DCM in Genomics England and increased left ventricular volumes in UK Biobank. DCM-associated variants reduced TAK1 kinase activity, supporting a loss-of-function mechanism consistent with CSCF-associated alleles. Conclusion: Multiple independent lines of evidence establish an association between MAP3K7 loss of function variants and DCM. Several affected individuals lacked overt syndromic features, demonstrating that MAP3K7-related disease may present as apparently isolated DCM across the lifespan and supporting inclusion of MAP3K7 in DCM diagnostic pipelines.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：扩张型心肌病（DCM）是心力衰竭和心源性猝死的一种遗传异质性病因。许多患者仍未获得分子诊断。MAP3K7 编码 TAK1，一种对心脏稳态重要的丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶。MAP3K7 变异是已知的综合征性疾病病因，包括心-脊柱-腕-面综合征（CSCF），其中偶有 DCM 的报道。在此，我们证明 MAP3K7 变异可导致貌似孤立的 DCM，从而扩展了 MAP3K7 相关疾病的表型谱。方法：我们整合了四条遗传学证据：新生变异、常见变异关联、家系分离和罕见变异富集，并结合功能表征。结果：在来自 100,000 基因组计划的 117 个儿科心肌病三人组中，两个先证者携带罕见的 MAP3K7 新生错义变异，显著高于预期（Bonferroni 校正 p=0.036）。独立的 GWAS 提示 MAP3K7 是成人 DCM 的易感位点。在全球 DCM 队列中，我们发现了携带罕见 MAP3K7 变异的家系，其中包括一个在九名患病亲属中分离的家系（p.(Tyr125Cys)，估计 LOD = 2.7）。罕见的破坏性非截短变异在 DCM 中相较于 INTERVAL（OR 22，p=0.007）和 gnomAD 对照（OR 14，p=6.2x10-4）富集，而截短变异在 Genomics England 中与 DCM 相关，并在 UK Biobank 中与左心室容积增加相关。DCM 相关变异降低了 TAK1 激酶活性，支持与 CSCF 相关等位基因一致的功能丧失机制。结论：多条独立证据线确立了 MAP3K7 功能丧失变异与 DCM 之间的关联。若干受影响个体缺乏明显的综合征特征，表明 MAP3K7 相关疾病可在整个生命周期中表现为貌似孤立的 DCM，并支持将 MAP3K7 纳入 DCM 诊断流程。

papers.title: Automated, Component-Level Assessment of a National Inpatient Diabetes Guideline: Adherence and Its Association with Hospitalization Complications Across Six Hospitals
papers.translated_title: 全国住院患者糖尿病指南的自动化组件级评估：六家医院的依从性及其与住院并发症的关联
papers.author: Oded, S.
papers.summary: Objective: To measure adherence to a national inpatient hyperglycemia guideline at the level of its individual recommendations across a hospital network, to determine whether it changed after the guideline was issued, and to identify which recommendations track subsequent outcomes. Materials and Methods: Retrospective multicenter study of 48,354 admissions among 29,577 adults with diabetes or inpatient hyperglycemia at six Israeli general hospitals, August 2022 to December 2025. Each of 14 recommendations was formalized as a quality-assessment temporal pattern over knowledge-based temporal abstractions of the record, scored wherever it applied. Pre-post adherence was compared by Welch t-test with false discovery rate correction. Associations with 10 complications were estimated by bias-reduced logistic regression over 24-, 48-, and 72-hour windows, and by inverse probability of treatment weighting contrasting above- with at-or-below-median adherence. Results: Adherence ranged from near-universal admission and medication-management actions to substantial gaps in insulin management (means, 0.15-0.28). Overall adherence rose modestly after issue (0.682 to 0.703, P < .001), with marked inter-hospital heterogeneity. After weighting, above-median adherence carried 44% lower odds of 30-day mortality (odds ratio [OR], 0.557; 95% CI, 0.514-0.603), 82% lower odds of hyperglycemia (OR, 0.175) and 52% lower odds of severe hyperglycemia (OR, 0.485), against 20% higher odds of hypoglycemia (OR, 1.204). Discussion: The least-implemented recommendations were largely those whose adherence tracked outcomes: repeated insulin decisions spread across a stay, rather than discrete actions on admission. Conclusion: Guideline adherence can be assessed automatically and per-recommendation at national scale, identifying where fuller implementation would most plausibly matter. Keywords: inpatient diabetes; clinical guideline adherence; quality assessment; temporal abstraction; electronic health records; propensity score; causal inference
papers.translated_summary: 目的：在一个医院网络内，按各条具体推荐意见衡量对国家住院高血糖指南的依从性，判断指南发布后依从性是否发生变化，并识别哪些推荐意见与后续结局相关。材料与方法：一项回顾性多中心研究，纳入以色列六家综合医院2022年8月至2025年12月期间29,577名糖尿病或住院高血糖成年患者的48,354次住院。将14条推荐意见中的每一条形式化为基于记录的知识型时间抽象之上的质量评估时间模式，并在其适用的所有情形下进行评分。采用Welch t检验并以错误发现率校正比较发布前后的依从性。通过偏倚校正逻辑回归在24、48和72小时窗口内估计与10种并发症的关联，并通过逆概率治疗加权对比高于中位数与等于或低于中位数的依从性。结果：依从性范围从近乎普遍的人院和药物管理措施，到胰岛素管理中的显著差距（均值，0.15-0.28）。发布后总体依从性略有上升（0.682至0.703，P < .001），且医院间异质性明显。加权后，高于中位数的依从性与30天死亡率低44%的比值比相关（比值比[OR]，0.557；95% CI，0.514-0.603），与高血糖低82%的比值比相关（OR，0.175），与严重高血糖低52%的比值比相关（OR，0.485），而与低血糖高20%的比值比相关（OR，1.204）。讨论：实施最少的推荐意见在很大程度上正是那些依从性与结局相关的推荐意见：贯穿整个住院期间反复进行的胰岛素决策，而非入院时的离散操作。结论：指南依从性可以在国家层面自动并按推荐意见逐条评估，从而识别出更充分实施最可能重要的环节。关键词：住院糖尿病；临床指南依从性；质量评估；时间抽象；电子健康记录；倾向评分；因果推断

papers.title: Diagnostic Concordance of Immediate Versus 1-Hour Technetium-99m Hydroxymethylene Diphosphonate Scintigraphy in Suspected Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy
papers.translated_title: 疑似转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病中即刻与1小时锝-99m羟亚甲基二膦酸盐闪烁显像的诊断一致性
papers.author: Costa, A.
papers.summary: Background: Bone-avid tracer myocardial scintigraphy for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) traditionally employs 1- or 3-hour imaging intervals. Technetium-99m hydroxymethylene diphosphonate (99mTc-HDP) has unique kinetics that may enable earlier imaging. We investigated the diagnostic concordance of immediate versus 1-hour acquisitions. Methods: Consecutive patients with suspected ATTR-CM underwent planar imaging and SPECT/CT immediately and at 1-hour following 99mTc-HDP administration. Perugini grades, heart-to-contralateral lung ratios, and target-to-background ratios (TBRs) using the LV septum against the aorta, LV blood-pool, and vertebrae were assessed. We evaluated diagnostic concordance using Cohen's kappa (k), temporal stability using paired t-tests, and correlation using Pearson's coefficient (r), with 1-hour SPECT/CT as the reference standard. Results: Forty-eight patients (83% male; median age, 80 years) were evaluated. One-hour SPECT/CT identified 19 positive and 29 negative cases. Immediate SPECT/CT demonstrated 100% diagnostic concordance with the 1-hour reference standard (k = 1.000; p < 0.001). The LV septum/blood-pool TBR showed highest correlation (r = 0.956; p < 0.001). Aorta TBR correlated highly (r = 0.918; p < 0.001) and remained stable in negative patients (-0.02; p = 0.54). Significant vertebral TBR decreases occurred across cohorts due to skeletal clearance. Conclusions: Immediate 99mTc-HDP SPECT/CT demonstrated high diagnostic concordance with standard 1-hour acquisitions, offering a practical approach to improve laboratory throughput.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：用于转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）的骨亲和性示踪剂心肌闪烁显像传统上采用1小时或3小时成像间隔。锝-99m羟亚甲基二膦酸盐（99mTc-HDP）具有独特的动力学特征，可能使更早期成像成为可能。我们研究了即刻与1小时采集的诊断一致性。方法：连续纳入疑似ATTR-CM的患者，在给予99mTc-HDP后即刻和1小时分别进行平面成像和SPECT/CT。评估Perugini分级、心脏与对侧肺比值，以及使用左心室间隔与主动脉、左心室血池和椎体比较的靶本底比值（TBR）。我们以1小时SPECT/CT作为参考标准，使用Cohen's kappa（k）评估诊断一致性，使用配对t检验评估时间稳定性，并使用Pearson系数（r）评估相关性。结果：共评估48例患者（83%为男性；中位年龄80岁）。1小时SPECT/CT识别出19例阳性和29例阴性病例。即刻SPECT/CT与1小时参考标准显示出100%的诊断一致性（k = 1.000；p < 0.001）。左心室间隔/血池TBR显示出最高相关性（r = 0.956；p < 0.001）。主动脉TBR相关性较高（r = 0.918；p < 0.001），且在阴性患者中保持稳定（-0.02；p = 0.54）。由于骨骼清除，各队列中椎体TBR均出现显著下降。结论：即刻99mTc-HDP SPECT/CT与标准1小时采集显示出高度诊断一致性，为提高实验室通量提供了一种实用方法。

papers.title: Updated Health Opportunity Cost Estimates for 92 Low- and Middle-Income Countries: Implications for Global Health Financing and Donor Allocation
papers.translated_title: 92个中低收入国家卫生机会成本估算更新：对全球卫生融资和捐助分配的影响
papers.author: Ochalek, J. M.
papers.summary: Background: Estimates of the marginal cost per disability-adjusted life year (DALY) averted from government health expenditure (GHE) provide an empirical basis for allocating scarce health resources to maximise population health. Existing cross-country estimates have informed priority setting in several countries and international policy discussions but are based on data that are now more than a decade old, during which patterns of health expenditure, disease burden, and global health financing have changed substantially. Methods: This paper provides updated estimates of the marginal cost per DALY averted for 92 low- and middle-income countries (LMIC), applying previously estimated elasticities of the effect of GHE on health outcomes from Ochalek et al. (2018) to recent mortality, morbidity, population, and GHE data. We model two scenarios: (1) countries raising domestic health expenditure to a tiered minimum of 10% or 15% of general government expenditure, depending on current level, with Abuja Declaration-consistent results for African Union countries reported separately; and (2) reallocating development assistance for health (DAH), considering both the targeting of existing on-budget support and the potential of the full DAH envelope. We use the estimated elasticities to reflect diminishing marginal returns to health expenditure when calculating the health gains associated with additional resources. Results: Updated estimates of the marginal costs per DALY averted range from approximately $54 to $18,547 across countries (average across DALY measures). In most countries (68%), estimates are higher than in the previous analysis, largely reflecting differences in GHE. Increasing domestic expenditure to the tiered minimum would avert 145 million DALYs but require $392 billion across countries. Reallocating the $11.2 billion in on-budget DAH according to country-specific opportunity costs would avert 75.3 million DALYs compared to the estimated 45.3 million averted by the current allocation of on-budget spending, though this requires redirecting funding away from many currently-funded countries. There is further potential to avert 66.1 million DALYs by optimally allocating the 25.7 billion portion of the DAH envelope that comes from off-budget, NGO and philanthropic resources, measured against a baseline in which they avert no DALYs. Conclusion: Updated estimates provide an empirical basis for informing both domestic priority setting and the allocation of international health financing. Aligning donor funding with country-specific opportunity costs could substantially increase the global health gains achieved with limited resources.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：对政府卫生支出（GHE）每避免一个伤残调整生命年（DALY）的边际成本的估算，为将稀缺卫生资源分配以实现人群健康最大化提供了实证依据。现有的跨国估算已为若干国家的优先事项设定和国际政策讨论提供了参考，但其依据的数据已超过十年，在此期间卫生支出模式、疾病负担和全球卫生融资都发生了重大变化。方法：本文提供了92个低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）每避免一个DALY的边际成本的最新估算，将Ochalek等人（2018）此前估算的GHE对健康结果影响的弹性应用于近期的死亡率、发病率、人口和GHE数据。我们模拟了两种情景：（1）各国将国内卫生支出提高至一般政府支出10%或15%的分级最低标准（取决于当前水平），其中与非盟国家《阿布贾宣言》一致的结果单独报告；（2）重新分配卫生发展援助（DAH），同时考虑现有预算内支持的目标定位以及全部DAH资源的潜力。在计算与额外资源相关的健康收益时，我们使用估算的弹性来反映卫生支出的边际收益递减。结果：各国每避免一个DALY的边际成本最新估算范围约为54美元至18547美元（各DALY指标的平均值）。在大多数国家（68%），估算值高于此前的分析，主要反映了GHE的差异。将国内支出提高至分级最低标准将避免1.45亿个DALY，但各国共需3920亿美元。根据各国特定的机会成本重新分配112亿美元的预算内DAH，将避免7530万个DALY，而当前预算内支出分配估计可避免4530万个DALY，不过这需要将资金从许多当前受资助国家转移出去。通过最优分配DAH资源中来自预算外、非政府组织和慈善资源的257亿美元部分，还有进一步避免6610万个DALY的潜力，衡量基准为其不避免任何DALY的情形。结论：最新估算为国内优先事项设定和国际卫生融资分配提供了实证依据。将捐助资金与各国特定的机会成本相协调，可在有限资源下大幅增加全球健康收益。

papers.title: Quantifying Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Using Artificial Intelligence-Based Matching
papers.translated_title: 使用基于人工智能的匹配量化癌症临床试验资格
papers.author: Goel, K. P.
papers.summary: PURPOSE: To develop and validate an artificial intelligence-enabled platform that combines efficient screening with explicit eligibility logic by converting unstructured cancer trial criteria into reusable structured queries, and illustrates potential eligibility using synthetic patients. METHODS: We downloaded actively recruiting US interventional treatment trials for advanced/metastatic breast cancer, colon cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer from ClinicalTrials.gov. Medical oncologists created 24 synthetic patient vignettes. A large language model converted trial eligibility criteria into Structured Query Language (SQL) code and patient information into structured records, enabling rule-based matching without further LLM inference. Cancer details and treatment history were considered, but not laboratory results or comorbidities. Validation included physician editing of generated eligibility code for 30 trials and independent assessments by two physicians, followed by consensus adjudication, for eligibility across ten trials. We descriptively summarized potential eligibility by trial characteristics and when varying age, ECOG performance status, sex, and ZIP code. RESULTS: Of 833 candidate trials, 746 met inclusion criteria. Performing matching for all 746 trials took a median of 0.459 seconds per patient, excluding patient-data preparation. Against physician consensus, automated matching agreed on 230/240 patient-trial pairs (95.8%; sensitivity 83.3%, specificity 100%). Across synthetic patients, potentially eligible trials ranged from 10 to 258 without geographic restrictions. Counts decreased with worse performance status and geographic restriction and were relatively stable across ages 30-90. Later-phase, randomized, and molecularly selective trials generally matched fewer vignettes. CONCLUSION: LLM-generated SQL enables rapid, explicit rule-based screening for potential trial eligibility. Evaluation in synthetic vignettes supports feasibility, while missed matches underscore the need for further validation.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：开发并验证一个人工智能赋能平台，该平台通过将非结构化的癌症试验标准转换为可复用的结构化查询，将高效筛选与明确的资格逻辑相结合，并利用合成患者展示潜在资格。方法：我们从ClinicalTrials.gov下载了正在积极招募的针对晚期/转移性乳腺癌、结肠癌和非小细胞肺癌的美国干预性治疗试验。医学肿瘤学家创建了24个合成患者案例。大型语言模型将试验资格标准转换为结构化查询语言（SQL）代码，并将患者信息转换为结构化记录，从而无需进一步的LLM推理即可进行基于规则的匹配。考虑了癌症详情和治疗史，但未考虑实验室结果或合并症。验证包括医生对30项试验生成的资格代码进行编辑，以及两名医生对十项试验的资格进行独立评估，随后进行共识裁定。我们按试验特征以及在不同年龄、ECOG体能状态、性别和邮政编码条件下，对潜在资格进行了描述性总结。结果：在833项候选试验中，746项符合纳入标准。对所有746项试验进行匹配，每位患者的中位时间为0.459秒，不包括患者数据准备时间。与医生共识相比，自动匹配在230/240个患者-试验配对中一致（95.8%；敏感性83.3%，特异性100%）。在合成患者中，无地理限制时潜在符合条件的试验范围为10至258项。随着体能状态变差和地理限制，数量减少，而在30-90岁年龄段相对稳定。后期阶段、随机化和分子选择性试验通常匹配较少的案例。结论：LLM生成的SQL能够实现快速、明确的基于规则的潜在试验资格筛选。在合成案例中的评估支持其可行性，而漏匹配则强调需要进一步验证。

papers.title: EDIT-B Consortium: An External Pan-European Validation of an Innovative Machine Learning-Based Test for Bipolar Disorder Diagnosis
papers.translated_title: EDIT-B联盟：一种用于双相情感障碍诊断的创新机器学习测试的泛欧洲外部验证
papers.author: Weissmann, D.
papers.summary: Background Differentiating bipolar disorder (BD) from major depressive disorder (MDD) during major depressive episodes remains a significant challenge. EDIT-B is an in vitro diagnostic test based on machine learning (ML) method integrating clinical metadata with adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) RNA editing signatures in eight genes (GAB2, IFNAR1, IL17RA, LYN, MDM2, PRKCB, PTPRC, ZNF267) to differentiate BD from MDD. Objective The objective of this study is to assess and confirm the diagnostic performance of EDIT-B in a new, independent, double-blind, external multicenter European cohort. Methods We evaluated EDIT-B results across four European centers (Spain, France, Denmark), compared to physician diagnoses. Explainability and sensitivity analyses were performed to identify the primary drivers of the model. Findings In 393 patients with current major depressive episode (238 MDD; 155 BD), EDIT-B demonstrated robust performance: AUC-ROC of 0.873 (95%CI: 0.837-0.909); sensitivity of 82.6% (95%CI: 75.7-88.2%); and specificity of 80.3% (95%CI: 74.6-85.1%). Performances were consistent across sites and all stratified patient subgroups, corroborating previous results. Explainability analysis pointed RNA editing biomarkers as the most important variables for EDIT-B diagnosis. Conclusion This study confirms the diagnostic performances of EDIT-B showing that A-to-I RNA editing coupled with ML methods is a reliable approach to distinguish BD from MDD. Clinical implications EDIT-B represents an innovative, reliable, and complementary diagnostic tool supporting psychiatric practice and enhancing clinical outcomes with potential impact in reducing the diagnostic delays, tailoring the therapeutic strategy and improving therapeutic alliances. These findings may represent a significant advance toward precision psychiatry, with potential to reduce misdiagnosis and inappropriate treatment.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 在重性抑郁发作期间，将双相障碍（BD）与重性抑郁障碍（MDD）区分开来仍然是一项重大挑战。EDIT-B是一种基于机器学习（ML）方法的体外诊断检测，整合了临床元数据与八个基因（GAB2、IFNAR1、IL17RA、LYN、MDM2、PRKCB、PTPRC、ZNF267）中的腺苷至肌苷（A-to-I）RNA编辑特征，以区分BD与MDD。目的 本研究的目的是在一个新的、独立的、双盲、外部欧洲多中心队列中评估并确认EDIT-B的诊断性能。方法 我们在四个欧洲中心（西班牙、法国、丹麦）评估了EDIT-B结果，并与医生诊断进行比较。进行了可解释性和敏感性分析，以识别模型的主要驱动因素。结果 在393例当前处于重性抑郁发作的患者中（238例MDD；155例BD），EDIT-B表现出稳健的性能：AUC-ROC为0.873（95%CI：0.837-0.909）；敏感性为82.6%（95%CI：75.7-88.2%）；特异性为80.3%（95%CI：74.6-85.1%）。各中心以及所有分层患者亚组中的性能一致，印证了先前的结果。可解释性分析指出RNA编辑生物标志物是EDIT-B诊断中最重要的变量。结论 本研究确认了EDIT-B的诊断性能，表明A-to-I RNA编辑结合ML方法是区分BD与MDD的可靠方法。临床意义 EDIT-B代表了一种创新、可靠且互补的诊断工具，可支持精神科实践并改善临床结局，其潜在影响包括减少诊断延迟、制定个体化治疗策略以及改善治疗联盟。这些发现可能代表朝着精准精神病学迈出的重要一步，并有可能减少误诊和不恰当治疗。

papers.title: Associations Between Salivary HHV-6 And Long COVID Severity in a Cross-Sectional, Case-Control Analysis
papers.translated_title: 唾液HHV-6与长新冠严重程度之间的关联：一项横断面病例对照分析
papers.author: Laxton, C. S.
papers.summary: Background Reactivation of human herpesviruses (HHVs), particularly EBV, is associated with more severe acute SARS-CoV-2 infection and the development of Long COVID (LC). Reactivation of HHVs has been previously implicated in hormonal dysregulation, which has also been observed in LC, suggesting a potential link. This study aims to examine the relationship between LC symptoms and salivary HHV DNA, cortisol, testosterone, and oestradiol levels. Methods Our cross-sectional, case-control study enrolled 45 participants with LC, and 45 age-sex-matched controls. Surveys and validated health questionnaires were used to collect demographics, medical history, and symptom profiles. Saliva was self-collected at waking, 15, 30, and 45 minutes, and 8 and 16 hours after waking, across two consecutive days. Salivary cortisol, testosterone and oestradiol were measured, and extracted nucleic acid was tested for EBV, HSV 1/2, HCMV and HHV-6 A/B using multiplex qPCR, and for SARS-CoV-2 and RNaseP using RT-qPCR. Findings Detection of salivary EBV and HHV-6 DNA copies was highest early in the morning. There were no significant differences in salivary cortisol, testosterone, or oestradiol, or in EBV or HHV-6 DNA between the LC and control groups. However, salivary HHV-6 DNA levels were positively associated with a greater aggregated LC propensity score (r= 0.24, 95% CI= 0.02 to 0.44, p= 0.015, adj. p= 0.030), as well as anxiety ({beta}= 0.69, 95% CI= 0.02 to 1.36, p= 0.045) and depression ({beta}= 0.24, 95% CI= 0.05 to 0.42, p= 0.013) scores. Interpretation The observed correlation between salivary HHV-6 DNA and symptom severity suggests HHV-6 may contribute to post-acute disease, though mechanisms remain unclear. While we did not identify a relationship between salivary EBV DNA and LC, EBV may still play a role at earlier time points in the disease course, or in compartments not sampled in this study. These findings highlight the potential importance of HHV-6 in LC pathophysiology and underscore the need for longitudinal, multi-compartment studies of herpesvirus reactivation in LC.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 人类疱疹病毒（HHVs），尤其是EBV的再激活，与更严重的急性SARS-CoV-2感染和长新冠（LC）的发生相关。HHV再激活此前已被认为与激素失调有关，而激素失调也在LC中被观察到，提示可能存在联系。本研究旨在探讨LC症状与唾液HHV DNA、皮质醇、睾酮和雌二醇水平之间的关系。方法 我们的横断面病例对照研究纳入了45名LC参与者和45名年龄性别匹配的对照者。使用调查问卷和经过验证的健康问卷收集人口学资料、病史和症状特征。参与者在连续两天内于醒来时、醒来后15、30和45分钟，以及醒来后8和16小时自行采集唾液。测定唾液皮质醇、睾酮和雌二醇，并使用多重qPCR检测提取的核酸中EBV、HSV 1/2、HCMV和HHV-6 A/B，使用RT-qPCR检测SARS-CoV-2和RNaseP。结果 唾液EBV和HHV-6 DNA拷贝的检出在清晨最高。LC组与对照组之间在唾液皮质醇、睾酮或雌二醇方面，或EBV或HHV-6 DNA方面均无显著差异。然而，唾液HHV-6 DNA水平与更高的聚合LC倾向评分呈正相关（r= 0.24，95% CI= 0.02至0.44，p= 0.015，校正p= 0.030），也与焦虑（{beta}= 0.69，95% CI= 0.02至1.36，p= 0.045）和抑郁（{beta}= 0.24，95% CI= 0.05至0.42，p= 0.013）评分呈正相关。解释 观察到的唾液HHV-6 DNA与症状严重程度之间的相关性提示，HHV-6可能促进急性期后疾病，尽管机制仍不清楚。虽然我们未发现唾液EBV DNA与LC之间的关系，但EBV仍可能在疾病病程更早的时间点发挥作用，或在本研究未采样的区室中发挥作用。这些发现凸显了HHV-6在LC病理生理学中的潜在重要性，并强调需要对LC中的疱疹病毒再激活开展纵向、多区室研究。

papers.title: BIRTH SPACING AND UNDER-FIVE CHILD SURVIVAL IN GHANA: EVIDENCE FROM THE 2022 DEMOGRAPHIC AND HEALTH SURVEY.
papers.translated_title: 加纳的生育间隔与五岁以下儿童存活：来自2022年人口与健康调查的证据。
papers.author: Siddiq, A. I.
papers.summary: Background: Short birth intervals are a well-documented, modifiable risk factor for child death in low- and middle-income countries, yet nationally representative evidence from Ghana's most recent Demographic and Health Survey has not been fully examined. This study assessed the association between the preceding birth interval and under-five mortality using the 2022 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey. Methods: The analysis used the complete birth history reported by women aged 15-49 years. The cohort comprised births occurring 60-119 completed months (5-10 years) before the survey, which allowed a complete five-year observation window for under-five survival (n = 8,418; 397 deaths). Spacing models were restricted to second-or-higher-order births with a defined preceding interval (n = 6,340; 282 deaths), categorised as under 18, 18-23, 24-35 (reference), 36-47, and 48 or more months. Crude and adjusted odds ratios were estimated using survey-weighted, Taylor-linearised logistic regression, adjusting for birth order, child sex, plurality, maternal age, residence, region, maternal education, wealth quintile, and marital status. Results: Weighted under-five mortality in the cohort was 45.4 per 1,000 live births (4.54%). Among second-or-higher-order births, weighted mortality fell from 9.3% after intervals of under 18 months and 8.0% after 18-23 months to 4.2%, 3.2%, and 3.5% after 24-35, 36-47, and 48 or more months, respectively. Relative to 24-35 months, the adjusted odds of death were higher after intervals of under 18 months (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] 2.58, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.48-4.49, p < 0.001) and 18-23 months (AOR 2.09, 95% CI 1.33-3.29, p = 0.001); longer intervals did not differ from the reference. Multiple birth (AOR 2.48, 95% CI 1.33-4.63) and having a mother who was never in union (AOR 3.25, 95% CI 1.29-8.17) were also associated with higher odds of death, and marked regional variation persisted after adjustment. Conclusion: A short preceding birth interval, particularly one of under 18 months, was independently associated with an approximately two- to two-and-a-half-fold increase in the odds of under-five death in this nationally representative sample. The findings support continued investment in postpartum family planning to help women space births at least 24 months apart, alongside closer attention to multiple births, unmarried mothers, and the regions carrying the greatest burden.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of deep learning for microsatellite instability prediction in gastric cancer: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 深度学习预测胃癌微卫星不稳定的诊断准确性：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Du, Y.
papers.summary: Deep learning (DL) applied to haematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained pathology images can predict microsatellite instability (MSI) in gastric cancer (GC). We evaluated its diagnostic accuracy and discriminative performance. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Web of Science were searched for studies applying DL to H&E images for MSI prediction in GC. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261503140). Risk of bias was assessed with QUADAS-2. Pooled sensitivity and specificity were estimated with a bivariate random-effects model, with subgroup analyses by validation strategy and data source; slide-level areas under the curve (AUCs) were pooled after logit transformation. Prespecified scenario analyses assessed robustness. Ten studies were included; seven independent datasets from six studies entered the primary synthesis. Pooled sensitivity, specificity and summary receiver operating characteristic AUC were 0.78 (95% CI 0.63-0.88), 0.85 (95% CI 0.77-0.90) and 0.89 (95% CI 0.86-0.91); nine studies contributed to the secondary AUC synthesis (pooled AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.89). Hospital-derived cohorts showed numerically higher sensitivity (0.86) and diagnostic odds ratio (39.8) than TCGA-derived cohorts (0.71 and 11.5), but subgroup differences were limited by the small number of studies and substantial heterogeneity. DL models show good diagnostic accuracy for MSI prediction in GC, but clinical utility still requires confirmation in standardised multicentre, independent external and prospective studies.
